verses.2: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.3: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord
verses.4: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
verses.5: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.6: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
verses.7: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in
verses.8: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in
verses.9: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
verses.10: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even
